how: Measure blood glucose with the onboard analyser, in mg/dL.
Note whether the crewmember has eaten recently.

why.text: No NASA HRP risk names blood glucose. It is tracked because a very low or very high value needs a doctor's attention.
why.uncovered_reason: No HRP risk names glucose; the closest is Risk of Inadequate Food and Nutrition.

if_abnormal.now: Check the sample and the analyser. Compare with the crewmember's own normal.
if_abnormal.remeasure: Measure again after the crewmember has rested, with the same device.
if_abnormal.tell_crew: Tell the crew medical officer. Any treatment is per flight surgeon / onboard medical checklist.
if_abnormal.tell_ground: Add the readings to the next ground report.

space_note: Safety bound 54 to 250 mg/dL: ADA level 2 limits (Table 6.2), an Earth reference, no space data. Inspiration4 astronauts (NASA OSDR OSD-575) had 3 of 28 values below 54 mg/dL, all 45 days after return.
labels: Earth reference, no space data (Safety bound)
